title: Open on bottom
text: Open on bottom. This is not a storage bag, it's a clothing top cover. The bottom is completely open, so your things are exposed. I had intended to use this for winter coat storage in the loft of our cabin, but because of the open bottom, that won't work. It is handy if just wanted to protect stuff from dust in a regular closet.
